channel.description: Latest articles from The Nevada Independent (thenevadaindependent.com)

item.title: Will Lombardo-backed measure affecting trans athletes make it to ballot? Judge weighs suit
item.description: Carson City Judge Jason Woodbury threw out an effort from supporters of the initiative to dismiss the lawsuit on the grounds that the naming of certain defendants was illegal. But he did not issue a ruling on the lawsuit itself.

item.title: IndyTalks: Cortez Masto calls Trump admin ‘racist,’ hints at future political plans
item.description: Nevada’s senior senator also answered questions on the Epstein files and the 2028 presidential race in a conversation with Nevada Independent CEO Jon Ralston.

item.title: Senadora por Nevada Catherine Cortez Masto califica de ‘racista’ al gobierno de Trump
item.description: Durante evento en Reno, la senadora Demócrata también respondió preguntas sobre los archivos Epstein y la contienda presidencial 2028.

item.title: Vegas police are big users of license plate readers. Public has little input because it’s a gift.
item.description: The Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department quietly entered an agreement in 2023 with Flock Security, an automated license plate reader company that uses cameras to collect vehicle information and cross-reference it with police databases. Unlike many of the other police departments around the country that use the cameras in their police work, Metro funds the project with donor money funneled into a private foundation.

item.title: OPINION: God is nonpartisan, Jesus isn’t a registered voter and other uncensored lessons
item.description: Talarico is an eighth-generation Texan, a state representative and the grandson of a Baptist preacher. He’s also a Presbyterian seminarian. In other words, he hasn’t just posed with the Bible, he’s actually read it.

item.title: Should the AG represent judges in misconduct cases? Nevada Supreme Court punts on answer
item.description: A Nye County judge had claimed in a July 2025 petition that the attorney general was required to provide her with legal counsel in judicial misconduct proceedings.

item.title: Clark County supe: Changing school start times is worth it, even in budget crunch
item.description: The Clark County School District superintendent said research the new school start times could lead to an improvement in student test scores.

item.title: Líder escolar del Condado Clark: Cambiar horario de inicio de clases vale la pena a pesar de costos
item.description: La superintendente del Distrito Escolar del Condado Clark reiteró que, a pesar de los retos presupuestarios que está por enfrentar, el cambio en la hora de inicio de clases trae beneficios académicos.

item.title: ‘Extremely frustrated’: Lawmakers irked as cost for autistic girls’ home quadruples
item.description: A state-backed campus offering resources to homeless people displaced the planned project, but finding an alternative has become increasingly complicated.

item.title: Qué saber acerca de la muerte del líder del Cártel Jalisco, y sus consecuencias
item.description: Algunos Demócratas que representan a Nevada en el Congreso dijeron que sus oficinas están disponibles para quienes requieran ayuda y animaron al público a inscribirse a un programa federal enfocado en ciudadanos estadounidenses que viajan o viven en el exterior.
